$comment: Goes in <project>/.claude/settings.json. Team baseline. Check this in. Personal allowances belong in settings.local.json (gitignored).

hooks.$comment: Fast last-line typecheck, shipped inert. Replace `true` with what is fast in your stack: bun typecheck, tsc --noEmit, mypy, cargo check, swift build. Keep a `2>&1 | tail -10` tail so errors do not flood the session end. The slot ships empty on purpose: a command for a toolchain you do not have would run at every session end.
